query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']) AND n.granularity='item' WITH n,EXISTS { MATCH (n)-[:definedInSection]->(:Section) } AS linked RETURN count(DISTINCT n) AS itemCount,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT linked THEN n ELSE null END) AS unlinkedCount,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT linked THEN n ELSE null END)=0 AS allLinked
